name: InMyAI

notes: Primary API runtime uses Python/FastAPI on 127.0.0.1:8000 in the standard development launcher.
The Next.js web client normally uses port 3000.
The desktop path uses a Tauri shell around the web client.
The Docker image may listen on 0.0.0.0 inside its container namespace; local-first host publishing must remain loopback-scoped.
A later coexistence phase should replace hard-coded development ports with the ecosystem port contract where safe.

limitations: Some privileged local capabilities depend on the host API and cannot be treated as a generic public web service.
Tauri previously ran successfully on Windows, but the Phase B1/C2 authority changes still need fresh Windows/Tauri E4 verification.
Source architecture has POSIX PTY support, but current macOS packaging/runtime evidence is not recorded.
Linux CI exercises the source/runtime stack, but desktop-shell release acceptance is not recorded.
Current product is a local desktop/web workspace; phone support should be introduced later as an authenticated control-only/provider-delegated client, not as a full local shell/filesystem runtime.
Current product is a local desktop/web workspace; phone support should be introduced later as an authenticated control-only/provider-delegated client, not as a full local shell/filesystem runtime.

secrets: provider API keys are BYOK/config references only
controls: Allowed-root policy for project content operations
Terminal WebSocket exact-Origin authorization before accept/PTY spawn
HTTP LocalAuthorityMiddleware rejects non-loopback Host authorities before FastAPI routes
HTTP browser origins are exact allowlisted for loopback/Tauri clients; private-LAN browser CORS is not accepted
The discovery health response is minimal and no longer exposes the database filesystem path
Raw GET /api/inmy/manifest is served behind the HTTP authority boundary
Terminal remains visibly documented as an unsandboxed real OS-user shell
knownOpenFindings: Fresh post-Phase-B1/C2 Windows/Tauri authority handshake is still required for E4.
Ecosystem identity/delegation/approval receipts are not yet implemented.
The real Terminal is intentionally unsandboxed after an approved local client connects.
Docker host-port publishing must remain loopback-scoped for local-first deployments.

resourceControls: Background indexing exposes status instead of blocking the primary UI flow.
Blocking PTY reads are moved off the asyncio event loop.
Terminal cleanup terminates the PTY process when the session closes.
Provider/model execution is optional and must fail visibly when unavailable.
knownBottlenecks: Formal startup, memory, bundle and representative API p95 budgets have not yet been measured.
Local model/OCR/indexing workloads can be materially heavier than the web shell and must be measured separately from optional provider/model memory.

limitations: Historical mobile screenshots predate later workspace changes and are not accepted as current mobile verification.
A phone client must not expose or emulate unrestricted desktop Terminal/filesystem authority.
Heavy indexing/model/tool work should execute on a trusted desktop/provider and stream status/results to mobile.

persistence: User-selected project files through controlled tooling
retention: Product-specific local persistence; formal ecosystem backup/retention policy is still future work.

externalExecutables: Tesseract OCR when OCR is used

notes: Search/index capability is local and project-scoped; Hub discovery may expose this metadata as R0 read-only, not execute project mutations.
Local OCR path; provider OCR is not implied.

sideEffects: Task execution may create controlled local artifacts or controlled writes depending on the selected tools.
notes: Hub integration must define exact tool permissions, idempotency and execution receipts before write-integrated status.

sideEffects: Arbitrary commands under the current OS user can read/write/delete files, start processes or access user-authorized network resources.
dataEgress: Depends on the command entered/executed by the user; unrestricted local shell network behavior is possible.
notes: This capability must never be selected as a silent fallback by InMyHub or an agent.
Current UI Terminal is intentionally interactive and unsandboxed after trusted Origin authorization.
